name: autofocus
label: Autofocus
description: when set to true, the component will recieve focus when it is finished mounting

name: description
label: Description
description: Additional content describing the field, usually to provide further instruction to the user

name: firstDayOfWeek
label: First Day of Week
description: What day of the week to begin the calendar.

name: format
label: Format
description: Format describing how to serialize/deserialize the `value` prop. By default it is `YYYY-MM-DD` or `YYYY-MM-DD hh:mm:ss a` depending on if you are showing a timepicker

name: invalid
label: Invalid
description: Specifies whether the current value is not valid

name: messages
label: Messages
description: Array of message objects that must contain type and message itself

name: name
label: Name
description: Name for the component. Any events dispatched by the component will use this name

name: readOnly
label: ReadOnly
description: Specifies that the user cannot modify the value of the component

name: required
label: Required
description: whether or not the user must fill in a value for this component

name: reversed
label: Reversed
description: Specifies that the field shoul dbe rendered right-to-left

name: onOk
label: Show `Ok` Button
description: Specifies whether or not to show the `Ok` button

name: onCancel
label: Show `Cancel` Button
description: Specifies whether or not to show the `Cancel` button

name: timePicker
label: Show Time Picker
description: Specifies whether or not to show the time picker in addition to the calendar
